info.name: FeastFlow — Online Food Ordering API
info.description:
Full REST API for the FeastFlow food ordering platform (Customer, Restaurant Owner, Delivery Partner, Admin). Import the companion "FeastFlow — Local" environment, then work through folders top to bottom: Auth -> Restaurants -> Categories -> MenuItems -> Cart -> Orders -> Delivery -> Reviews -> Notifications. Requests that create a resource save its id into an environment variable (e.g. {{restaurantId}}) for later requests to reuse.

Admin endpoints require an admin account, which cannot self-register via the API by design (see ARCHITECTURE.md). Create one by registering a normal user then flipping its `role` to `admin` directly in MongoDB, log in, and paste the returned accessToken into the `adminAccessToken` environment variable.

A restaurant must be approved by an admin (Admin > Approve Restaurant) before checkout will succeed.

New restaurants start unapproved. An admin must approve it (see Admin folder) before checkout will work.
Attach image files to the `logo` and/or `cover` fields (Postman: select file in the form-data row).
Destructive — cascades to the restaurant's categories and menu items. Run this last.
Fails with 409 if the category still has menu items — delete those first.
Requires a non-empty cart and an approved, open restaurant. Simulates a payment gateway charge — non-COD methods have a small chance of a realistic decline.
